messages.author: 3286fc25c6432b38
messages.subject: Installing aroma.affymetrix on Mac
parts:
Hi,

I've been running aroma.affymetrix on our unix and linux machines at
work. I've been wanting to take do some work at home. So I installed R
on my Mac laptop. I've tried installing aroma.affymetrix but was
unsuccessful. It seems that I can get version 1.6.2 of affxparser
using biocLite(). However, when I ask it to load the package, I'm
told:

> library(affxparser)
Error in dyn.load(x, as.logical(local), as.logical(now)) :
unable to load shared library '/Users/silver/Library/R/library/
affxparser/libs/ppc/affxparser.so':
dlopen(/Users/silver/Library/R/library/affxparser/libs/ppc/
affxparser.so, 6): Symbol not found:
__ZN20affymetrix_fusion_io13FusionCELData7GetStdvEi
Referenced from: /Users/silver/Library/R/library/affxparser/libs/ppc/
affxparser.so
Expected in: dynamic lookup
Error: package/namespace load failed for 'affxparser'

When I try to get affxparser using hbLite(), I'm told

> hbLite("affxparser")
Using repository: http://www.braju.com/R/repos
Identified packages to be processed: affxparser
Searching for locally installed packages...done
Updating packages: affxparser
01/01. affxparser: not available.
Detected R option pkgType="mac.binary", which is not available.
Enforcing installation from source instead for packages:
NULL
Warning message:
Detected R option pkgType="mac.binary", which is not available.
Enforcing installation from source instead for packages: in:
hbLite("affxparser")

When I try installing aroma.affymetrix, I'm told

> hbLite("aroma.affymetrix")
... ...
Error: package 'affxparser' 1.6.2 was found, but >= 1.7.3 is required
by 'aroma.affymetrix'
Execution halted

Any suggestions?

Thanks,

Jeremy

messages.author: 0e065001d5e74ca3
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Installing aroma.affymetrix on Mac
parts:
Hi Jeremy,

You need to use biocLite() to get the devel versions of affxparser and
affyPLM. See

http://groups.google.com/group/aroma-affymetrix/web/download-install

In particular:

# Required Bioconductor packages (developer versions)
biocLite(c("affxparser", "affyPLM"), rver="2.5.0")

Cheers,

Ken

messages.author: 41ed89aa70b5d27c
messages.subject: Re: Installing aroma.affymetrix on Mac
parts:
You need to make sure you are compiling from source, using
biocLite(..., type = "source")

You will need the CRAN version of GCC 4.0.3 as well as Xcode 2.4.1.

affxparser does not work on Inten Macs however. This will be fixed in
R-2.5.0 where the compiler changes.

Kasper
